subject: Quota-aligned hiring case & comp-band decision for Q3 ramp
content:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Amy Ho <amy@brightedge.com>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Quota-aligned hiring case & comp-band decision for Q3 ramp

Team,

We have two priority requisitions that need final sign-off before we convert them to offers this week: one AE (Enterprise) and one Solutions Engineer to support the east coast accounts. Amy has already surfaced strong candidates for each; Samir Patel is the SE in question (profile attached).

Ask: I need approval on the comp bands to use and confirmation we can allocate the headcount under the Q3 quota cushion column in the hiring matrix. I attached the q3_quota_hiring_matrix.xlsx and comp_band_recommendation_v2.csv. Key points below: 

- Role AE-ENT-3: recruitment grade A. Pending offer budget: OTE target 170k with 12% variable top-up for quota overachievement. Comp band being proposed: 150k-190k OTE.
- Role SE-ENG-2: candidate Samir Patel proposed. Proposed comp band: 130k-160k OTE; candidate asks 155k.
- Headcount: we have 2 seats available in the Q3 cushion bucket but the AE seat would be reallocated from a delayed outbound hire.

Decision needed by EOD Thursday so we can share terms with Amy and move to verbal. If either band is outside acceptable thresholds I can rework the plan to shift comp from other pipeline hires or propose a signing bonus instead of raising base.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Field GTM Operations
Redwood Inference

---

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Amy Ho <amy@brightedge.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quota-aligned hiring case & comp-band decision for Q3 ramp

Vanessa,

Thanks for the summary and attachments. Quick take: AE band looks OK given Q3 quota lift and GTM gap. For the SE role, I prefer keeping base within band and making up the rest with a one-time sign-on if the candidate is above market. 155k OTE for Samir is slightly high relative to our standard SE-2 band.

Please confirm: is Samir required to be remote east-coast or is hybrid an option? If hybrid is acceptable we can justify a slightly lower OTE.

Ben
Ben Carter
VP, Sales
Redwood Inference

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Amy Ho <amy@brightedge.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Jun 2028 14:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quota-aligned hiring case & comp-band decision for Q3 ramp

Team,

I reviewed the matrix and comp bands. Two pragmatic suggestions:

1) For AE-ENT-3, approve the 150k-190k OTE band but cap initial offer at 165k OTE with a 10k signing bonus contingent on 6-month quota attainment. This keeps our first-year cost predictable while giving upside.

2) For Samir (SE), I'm willing to approve 155k OTE if we structure it as 135k base + 20k performance bonus (accelerators for platform onboarding and first three closed deals). That reduces fixed comp pressure and aligns pay to output.

If Ben and Jonas are good with the structure I can prepare offer language and the comp memo for finance.

Marissa Cole
Head of Talent Operations, GTM
Redwood Inference

---

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Amy Ho <amy@brightedge.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@gmail.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 17:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quota-aligned hiring case & comp-band decision for Q3 ramp

All,

Thanks for the back-and-forth. I approve Marissa's structures for both hires and confirm we can pull the two seats from the Q3 cushion in the hiring matrix. Finance is looped and expects the comp memo by Monday — Marissa, if you can drop the memo to the shared drive link and cc finance, we can route the offer approvals today.

Amy / Samir: expect a formal verbal from Marissa today and a written offer early next week. Samir, re: location — hybrid east-coast is fine; we'll adjust the relocation/sign-on construct accordingly.

Jonas Weber
SVP, Go-to-Market
Redwood Inference

----

Attachments referenced: q3_quota_hiring_matrix.xlsx, comp_band_recommendation_v2.csv, samir_profile.pdf

Thread metadata note: internal participants limited to the Redwood employee list in the mailbox. External participants are the recruiter and candidate above.
